evals.name: greenfield-intake
evals.prompt: I want to research whether our engineering org should standardize on one MCP gateway. I need an architecture brief for platform leads. Use our ticketing and docs systems, but don't create anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Produces a complete draft research configuration covering objective/audience, scope and exclusions, evidence/output expectations, logical subsystem roles and readiness, mutation boundary, approval gates, and unresolved assumptions; it performs no external mutation and asks for approval before planning.

evals.name: brownfield-adoption
evals.prompt: Pick up an existing research effort in this folder. It already has RESEARCH.md, STATE.md, tickets and documents. Figure out what is there and help me continue it.
evals.expected_output: Discovers and reconciles existing durable project state and subsystem resources before proposing changes; preserves existing configuration/state, identifies inconsistencies or unresolved roles, and does not recreate or mutate external resources during setup.

evals.name: missing-provider-capability
evals.prompt: Start research on current MCP authorization patterns. We definitely need a document store, but I don't know whether this host has one configured.
evals.expected_output: Marks the required document_store capability as unresolved/pending rather than inventing a provider, records the blocker, avoids credentials/host-specific assumptions, and does not proceed to initialization while a required role is unresolved.
